svg.title: burn: training MNIST, live in the terminal
svg.desc: burn: training MNIST, live in the terminal: a recorded terminal session, 27 s, looping. Steps: 1 · burn trains MNIST on the CPU; the dashboard comes up / 2 · accuracy climbs, batch by batch / 3 · → the loss plot / 4 · ↓ recent history instead of the full one / 5 · → the learning rate / 6 · q: stop, kill or cancel / 7 · c: cancel, the training goes on / 8 · q, k: kill it; the terminal comes back clean

g.text: Stop the training immediately. This will break from the training loop,
but any remaining code after the loop will be executed.
Kill the program. This will abort the current training instantly. Any
code following the training won't be executed.
Cancel the action, continue the training.

svg.text: burn: training MNIST, live in the terminal

text.tspan: burn trains MNIST on the CPU; the dashboard comes up
↓ recent history instead of the full one
c: cancel, the training goes on
q, k: kill it; the terminal comes back clean
